title: MACP canonical commitment hash test vector
description: A reference vector for RFC-MACP-0013. A COMPUTE vector (Section 4, canonical commitment hash algorithm) pins the projected payload, the JCS-canonicalized bytes, the domain-separated preimage, and the resulting hash so a diverging implementation can identify at which step it diverged; verifying its own hash against the payload's wire encoding is *match*. A VERIFY vector (Section 6) pins a payload's Protobuf wire encoding, a claimed hash, and the one outcome a conforming verifier MUST return. This is a different shape from schemas/conformance/schema.json (session transcripts) and is validated separately.

name.description: Vector identifier; MUST match the file's basename (without .json).

label.description: The commitment-hash label (RFC-MACP-0013 Section 5/7) that produced this vector.

payload.description: The CommitmentPayload projection (RFC-MACP-0013 Section 3), exactly as hashed.

supersedes.description: Present only when the payload's supersedes field is set (RFC-MACP-0013 Section 3, rule 3). Absent entirely otherwise -- never null or {}.

jcs_utf8_hex.description: Lowercase hex encoding of the UTF-8 bytes of the RFC 8785 JCS canonicalization of 'payload'.

preimage_utf8_hex.description: Lowercase hex encoding of the UTF-8 bytes of 'macp-commitment-hash/1:' concatenated with the JCS bytes.

hash.description: The canonical commitment hash: sha256: followed by 64 lowercase hex characters.

must_differ_from.description: Name of another vector whose 'hash' this vector's 'hash' MUST NOT equal. Machine-checked by scripts/check-cmt-hash-vectors.py.

wire_hex.description: Verify vectors only: lowercase hex of the CommitmentPayload's Protobuf wire encoding, exactly as received, so unknown fields stay observable. May be empty: a zero-length encoding is the all-default payload (RFC-MACP-0013 Section 6).

claimed_hash.description: Verify vectors only: the hash a counterparty claims for the payload. Deliberately unconstrained: a claim not in canonical form is a valid input whose outcome is mismatch (RFC-MACP-0013 Section 6).

expected_outcome.description: Verify vectors only: the one outcome a conforming verifier MUST return (RFC-MACP-0013 Section 6). cannot_verify is reserved for the payload encoding, never the claim.
